## NEWEST ENTRY: 2026-09-01 — Claude Fable 5.1 + Claude Mythos 5.1. LARGE entry, 8 bullets.
## (Reusable lesson holds: Anthropic ships very large single-day entries. Read every bullet.)

2026-09-01 — MODELS
- claude-fable-5-1 (all customers) and claude-mythos-5-1 (Project Glasswing participants ONLY).
  1M context = DEFAULT AND MAXIMUM. 128k max output. Adaptive thinking ALWAYS ON.
  $10/$50 per MTok, same as Fable 5. CACHE READS $0.25/MTok = 0.025x base input
  (vs 0.1x on every other Claude model).
  Availability: Claude API, Amazon Bedrock (anthropic.claude-fable-5-1), Claude Platform on AWS,
  Google Cloud, Microsoft Foundry (on Anthropic infrastructure).
  Mythos 5.1 access = Anthropic, AWS or Google Cloud ACCOUNT TEAMS. Same channel as Mythos 5.
  Both: 30-day retention REQUIRED, not available under ZDR without express Anthropic authorization.
  Both are "Covered Models".

## *** KEY DIVERGENCE — REPORTED 2026-09-02, HIGH/AIRT ***
## Fable 5.1 enforces a thinking-block PREFIX-INTEGRITY CHECK. Editing system prompt, tools, or any
## earlier message invalidates every later thinking block; replay => 400
##     "The block is bound to a different conversation"
## Enforced for accounts created ON OR AFTER 2026-08-31. Older accounts: recorded but only acted on
## when thinking.block_binding.prefix_mismatch_behavior is set.
## >>> "Claude Mythos 5.1 doesn't run this check." <<<
## => this is a DEPLOYMENT FINGERPRINT for Mythos, far more reliable than refusal probes.
##    (Refusal probes still falsely pass — see claude-mythos-5-safeguards-lifted memory.)

BREAKING (Fable 5.1 + Mythos 5.1):
1. tool_choice {"type":"any"} and {"type":"tool",...} => 400 invalid_request_error.
   "tool_choice: type \"tool\" and \"any\" are not supported for this model."
   Same validation on the token-counting endpoint. auto/none unchanged.
   => ANY Zenity harness or red-team fixture pinning a tool call breaks silently -> falls back to auto.
2. Thinking blocks bound to producing model. Fable 5.1 reads earlier models' blocks; no earlier model
   reads Fable 5.1's. Cross-model drop is SILENT unless beta header thinking-binding-controls-2026-08-01,
   which reports it in a top-level `input_transformations` array (reason: "prefix_binding_mismatch").
3. Prefix-integrity check above.

ADDITIVE (new beta headers — all three are new parser surface):
- mid-conversation-output-config-2026-07-01 — PER-MESSAGE EFFORT. A role:"system" message inside
  `messages` carrying output_config.effort changes effort for later turns WITHOUT invalidating cache.
  Fable 5.1, Mythos 5.1, Opus 5.
- mid-conversation-system-clear-at-2026-08-21 — TURN-SCOPED SYSTEM MESSAGES.
  role:"system" + clear_at:"next_user_message". Text "carries SYSTEM-PROMPT AUTHORITY for the current
  turn", then stops rendering. Stays in messages, costs ZERO input tokens once cleared.
  => anything that can append to `messages` can inject system-level instruction for one turn.
- thinking-display-updates-2026-08-18 — thinking.display accepts a THIRD value "updates".
  Reasoning returns empty; the model's inter-tool-call progress updates return AS TEXT.
  (default remains "omitted"; "summarized" also returns them.)

CONTENT PROVENANCE (new):
- Text from Fable 5.1 / Mythos 5.1 carries Anthropic's STATISTICAL TEXT WATERMARK on EVERY platform
  where the model is available. No tokens, no hidden chars, no org-identifying info.
- Images/videos produced via the CODE EXECUTION TOOL carry signed C2PA Content Credentials when
  retrieved through the Files API on the Claude API.

BEHAVIOUR CHANGES worth carrying (from whats-new-fable-5-1):
- Parallel tool calling MORE VARIABLE: may issue one tool call per turn where Fable 5 batched.
- FEWER progress updates during long tool runs.
- Answers from memory more often at `low` effort (calls search/retrieval tools less).
- MORE LIKELY TO REWRITE A WHOLE FILE than make a targeted edit => larger blast radius per action.
- Unmarked quotations in summaries.
Fallback targets for a refused Fable 5.1 request: Claude Opus 4.8 and Claude Opus 5.

2026-08-27 — *** PERSONAL KEYS + SERVICE ACCOUNT KEYS *** (REPORTED 2026-09-02, MEDIUM/AISPM)
  New credential types in the Claude Console. "Act as you or as a service account, with the same
  permissions, and stop working when the linked account is removed from an organization."
  Scope: EITHER a specific workspace OR "work on admin endpoints and across ANY workspace the account
  has access to."  Workspace API keys remain as a LEGACY option.
  => three credential types now coexist; org-scoped personal keys are the privileged case.
2026-08-27 — SDK beta-header migration (reported/held 08-30): client.beta.files / client.beta.skills
  stop sending files-api-2025-04-14 and skills-2025-10-02; BetaSkill -> BetaContainerSkill.

2026-08-26 — Compliance API session endpoints GA for Cowork + Claude Code; local endpoints now return
  claude_science and office_agents/* transcripts; Admin API in `ant` CLI + 7 SDKs under
  client.beta.organization. (All reported 08-26/08-27.)
